facts.text: Sit down, Will. This fish was bigger than the boat, and I'll tell you all about it over dinner.
facts.why: Invented line signed Edward Bloom. His fish talk in the film is things like 'The biggest fish in the river gets that way by never being caught.'
facts.fix: The biggest fish in the river gets that way by never being caught.

fix_note.text: The biggest fish in the river gets that way by never being caught.

facts.text: Spectre style. Leave your shoes on the line.
facts.why: TV Tropes says Spectre takes visitors' shoes so everyone goes barefoot. Nothing I opened describes a line of shoes.
facts.fix: Spectre style. Leave your shoes at the edge of town.

vibe.verdict: A pretty invite that picks the right Spectre, Karl and circus bits, but the plates are plain and the giant catfish never reaches the table.
missing: The Beast, the giant catfish Edward catches with his wedding ring (Will's wedding party)
A field of daffodils outside Sandra's window (Auburn)
Karl the giant eating a cornfield and a neighbour's dog (Ashton)
Norther Winslow's three-line poem about Spectre
Amos Calloway, the ringmaster who is a werewolf
The witch's glass eye that shows Edward his death
ideas: Swap 'Whole snapper' in The Big Fish for a whole fried catfish, the fish in the story.
Swap the cream soda note for 'Truth is, I've been thirsty my whole life' (Edward in Spectre).
Swap the place card line 'Seated near: Karl the giant' for 'Seated near: Amos Calloway, who sells one fact about Sandra a month.'
Swap 'Daffodil lemon cake' for a yellow daffodil cake, served with a sprig of daffodil, from Sandra's window scene.
